messages.subject: Cut your due diligence review time by 40% — see Clarion in action
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Leading corporate teams are using Clarion's AI-assisted data room review to surface change-of-control clauses, assignment restrictions and unusual indemnities in minutes rather than days. We'd love to show you a 20-minute demo tailored to your transactional practice.

Are you free for a quick call the week of 13 October? Reply here or book directly at clariondiligence.com/demo.

Best,
The Clarion Team

Unsubscribe | Clarion Legal Tech Ltd, Manchester
